# Mehedi Hasan Abir

> Mehedi Hasan Abir is a Senior AI/ML Engineer in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with 5+ years of experience building production AI systems: LLM applications, RAG, document intelligence, search, and model inference and serving. He writes about practical AI engineering on mhabir.dev and in Towards AI on Medium (@mhabir102).

## About

- [About Mehedi Hasan Abir](https://mhabir.dev/about/): experience, education and background
- [Selected work](https://mhabir.dev/works/): AI/ML projects and case studies
- [Research](https://mhabir.dev/research/): IEEE paper on Bengali intent classification (BNIntent30, GAN-BnBERT) and ECG classification work

## Writing

- [15 Best GitHub Repos for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode](https://mhabir.dev/blog/best-github-repos-claude-code-codex-opencode/): agent skills and tools for AI coding agents, grouped by job, with install commands
- [12 Claude Skills for Slides, Reports and Marketing](https://mhabir.dev/blog/claude-skills-for-slides-reports-marketing/): open-source skills that build decks, reports, landing pages, videos and marketing copy with no coding
- [AI Coding Harness: 4 Files That Give Claude Code and OpenCode Memory](https://mhabir.dev/blog/ai-coding-harness/): AGENTS.md, SESSION.md, CHECKLIST.md and HANDOFF.md for Claude Code and OpenCode
- [How to Use, Optimize, and Serve an LLM in Your Production System](https://mhabir.dev/blog/llm-in-production/): model-level optimization, serving for P95/P99 latency, and choosing an inference engine
- [How I Built an Offline Hazari Scoring App](https://mhabir.dev/blog/hazari-scoring-app/): an offline-first PWA scorekeeper with a live scoreboard
- [All writing](https://mhabir.dev/blog/)
